real: PT-76 / ZBD-05 amphibious light tank line (unit_sheet: S-60 57 mm (2A91), PKT / M240 coax)
shape: unit_sheet.json Phương tiện: a low boat-shaped (amphibious) hull, a small turret set forward, a long slim 57 mm gun; from above the bow pointed like a boat; about 6.1 x 2.6 x 1.8 m (0.8 x PT-76 / ZBD-05); team stripes on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.
confidence: xấp xỉ (PT-76 / ZBD-05 published layout; the turret is a compact modern design for the 57 mm)

features.feature: the welded boat hull (Team) pointed in plan, the folded trim vane on the bow with hinges
the driver's hatch with periscopes, engine deck grilles, exhaust louvres at the stern
two water-jet ports and their covers at the stern, tail lamps, tow hooks, headlamps
six road wheels, rear sprocket, front idler on its arm, a linked track
side skirts with rubber flaps over the top run
the compact angular turret forward of the middle with its rear bin, the mantlet, the long 57 mm with fume extractor and slotted brake, the coax
the gunner's sight head, the commander's cupola with a 7.62 mm pintle gun on its post, smoke launchers on both flanks
deck stowage: the snorkel tube, a tarpaulin roll, two crates; Team bands
